changes.before: Implement submit/get/list: no input mutation, strict field whitelist/defaults, dup/unknown/self/cycle check incl. DB deps, atomic single-TX batch, idempotent same-spec no-op, exact 12-key detached sorted views.
changes.proposed: Implement submit/get/list: no input mutation, strict field whitelist/defaults, dup/unknown/self/cycle check incl. DB deps, atomic single-TX batch, idempotent same-spec no-op, exact ten-key detached sorted views.

changes.before: Views: exact 12-key detached copies, sorted unique deps, list sorted by ID, get/list validate IDs and never implicitly recover.
changes.proposed: Views: exact ten-key detached copies, sorted unique deps, list sorted by ID, get/list validate IDs and never implicitly recover.

changes.before: Atomic submit: full pre-TX validation, dup/unknown/self/unknown-dep/cycle reject whole batch with no writes and no recovery side-effects; idempotent same normalized spec is no-op.
changes.proposed: Atomic submit: type checks before TX; graph/spec checks inside the write TX, dup/unknown/self/unknown-dep/cycle reject whole batch with no writes and no recovery side-effects; idempotent same normalized spec is no-op.

changes.before: Invalid batch partially mutating or triggering recovery; mitigated by full validation before TX and single-TX rollback.
changes.proposed: Invalid batch partially mutating or triggering recovery; mitigated by type checks before TX, graph/spec checks inside TX, and rollback.

changes.before: Run python3.12 -m unittest tests.test_regress -v: two processes claim same job get distinct owners; committed jobs survive close/reopen.
changes.proposed: Run python3.12 -m unittest tests.test_regress -v: two processes compete for one job: exactly one gets its lease, the other gets null; committed jobs survive close/reopen.

changes.before: Implement strict validators and atomic submit plus get list: bool-is-not-int, finite JSON, allowed fields, no caller mutation, sorted-unique deps, reject dup unknown self cycle, idempotent only on exact original-spec match, detached 12-key views sorted by ID.
changes.proposed: Implement strict validators and atomic submit plus get list: bool-is-not-int, finite JSON, allowed fields, no caller mutation, sorted-unique deps, reject dup unknown self cycle, idempotent only on exact original-spec match, detached ten-key views sorted by ID.

changes.before: Atomic submit with detached 12-key views sorted by ID; invalid batch leaves DB unchanged.
changes.proposed: Atomic submit with detached ten-key views sorted by ID; invalid batch leaves DB unchanged.

changes.before: Implement claim with recovery then priority-desc id-asc eligible pick and attempts increment; recover reset with ready_at rules; complete and fail with running plus owner plus attempt plus lease checks, retry_delay cap and terminal guards.
changes.proposed: Implement claim with recovery then priority-desc id-asc eligible pick and attempts increment; recover reset with ready_at rules; complete and fail with running plus owner plus attempt plus lease checks, nonnegative retry_delay and max_attempts cap and terminal guards.

changes.before: Run python3.12 CLI matrix via python3.12 -m durable_queue --db PATH --request FILE checking success JSON and exit-2 cases for bad JSON, UTF-8, op, fields and missing DB.
changes.proposed: Run python3.12 CLI matrix via python3.12 -m durable_queue --db PATH --request FILE checking success JSON and exit-2 cases for bad JSON, UTF-8, op, fields and unavailable DB.

changes.before: In one IMMEDIATE txn: claim recovers expiries then claims eligible job by prio DESC,id ASC; recover maps expired to pending/failed; complete/fail guard running+owner+attempt+now<lease before any write, clear lease, apply bounded retry_delay.
changes.proposed: In one IMMEDIATE txn: claim recovers expiries then claims eligible job by prio DESC,id ASC; recover maps expired to pending/failed; complete/fail guard running+owner+attempt+now<lease before any write, clear lease, apply nonnegative retry_delay with retries bounded by max_attempts.

changes.before: Submit is atomic, strictly validated, idempotent on normalized spec match, returns detached sorted views; get/list sorted, validated, no implicit recovery.
changes.proposed: Submit is atomic, strictly validated, idempotent on normalized spec match, returns detached views in submission order; get validates IDs, list sorts by ID, no implicit recovery.
